answer_1.quote: We experiment across 10 information-seeking datasets from the  and ALCE  benchmarks.
answer_1.outputs: The generated responses are in the form of long-form answers that may include retrieved knowledge grounding, marked by special tokens [CS] and [CE], and involve multi-step reasoning with external knowledge retrieval indicated by [NSP].

answer_2.quote: We measure model performance via three metrics. Correctness and grounding performance measures the generation ability of the model and how well it utilizes knowledge from the external sequence. Retrieval performance mainly measures how well the model finds relevant sequences.

answer_3.quote: Following the approach of previous works , we use TRUE , a T5-11B model finetuned on various NLI datasets, to see whether the external knowledge entails a part of the response that is generated based on the knowledge.
